verdict.rationale: Terraform's actual interface is declarative HCL config plus a structured CLI (plan/apply/import/state) and JSON machine-readable output; the MCP server (terraform-docs-10/23, terraform-probe-9) only gives AI models read access to provider docs, modules, and policies — it does not let a user issue natural-language commands that Terraform executes to change infrastructure. No evidence shows an NL-to-action interface for actually operating Terraform.
